subject: Retention hold request for accreditation audit — Acme Health
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: retention hold for upcoming accreditation audit

Hi Monica,

We received notice that Acme Health will undergo a formal accreditation audit starting 2026-12-02. The auditors have requested a hold on scheduled backups/backup purges and an 18-month retention of related application logs and request traces tied to patient-data flows for a defined set of accounts. This is time-sensitive — the audit team asked for confirmation of preservation steps by COB 2026-11-20.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Pause any automatic backup purge for Acme Health buckets (project: acme-prod) immediately
- Preserve request and app logs associated with the account for at least 18 months (override standard 90-day TTL)
- Provide a signed DPA addendum reflecting the legal hold and subprocessors list (including regions)

I've attached the audit notice (audit_notice.pdf) and copied our legal team. Please advise next steps and an internal contact for immediate coordination.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Compliance, Acme Health

---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention hold for upcoming accreditation audit

Thanks for the heads-up, Lena — we can support, but need to coordinate across legal and infra. Proposed immediate actions:

1) Technical hold: Rishi, please pause purge_job_472 for project acme-prod and snapshot the current bucket state.
2) Logs: preserve request/app logs for 18 months via TTL override; note cost impact and storage class changes.
3) Legal: Kimberly, can we prep a DPA addendum (one-off retention hold) and include subprocessors + region disclosures?
4) Operational confirmation: I'll send a confirmation email to Acme once infra/legal confirm and include an ETA.

Attachments referenced by Acme: audit_notice.pdf — I attached for internal review.

Monica
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 10:05 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads-up, Lena — we can support, but need to coordinate across legal and infra.

Monica — happy to take the DPA addendum. Quick asks for scope:
- Precise data categories (PII, PHI, request metadata) and the prefix/path in S3/GCS to put under hold
- Whether Acme wants a hold on snapshots/s3 versioning and server-side backups (we can)
- Term: temporary hold until 2028-01-01 or audit-closed — will draft a timeboxed addendum

I'll attach an initial draft: DPA_addendum_draft.docx. Legal will need a signed execution (DocuSign) before we mark formal legal hold; in practice we can implement a technical hold immediately and mark it "subject to executed addendum".

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 18, 2026 at 11:40 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Monica — happy to take the DPA addendum. Quick asks for scope:

We implemented a technical hold on 2026-11-19 08:15 PST:
- purge_job_472 (scheduled purge for acme-prod) set to PAUSED (job id: purge_job_472)
- Created snapshot: acme-prod-snapshot-20261119 (SOC2_snapshot_20261118.pdf attached as reference)
- Applied TTL override: logs/* -> 547 days (18 months); previous TTL was 90 days
- Updated retention metadata on objects with tag:retention=acme_audit_hold_20261119

Impact/notes:
- Estimated incremental storage cost: ~$1,200/month while hold is active (will refine)
- Manual purges are disabled for resources with tag retention=acme_audit_hold_20261119
- purge_job_472.log attached so legal can see exact job state and operations (purge_job_472.log)

If legal requests a narrower path scope, we can scope the TTL override to prefixes. Please confirm whether snapshots and server backups should also be excluded from purge.

Rishi
